personal.name: Aarav Mehta
personal.tagline: I turn rough ideas into polished web products that people actually find useful.
personal.bio: I'm a freelance developer who partners with founders to build software end to end. Hand me a problem and I'll take the whole path, data model, API, interface, and the deploy that puts it in front of real users, with a focus on reliability and the small details that make an app feel right.

experience.description: Running a one-person studio for early-stage startups, scoping the work, standing up the backend and frontend, wiring integrations, and shipping to production, then staying on to maintain and improve what I build.

services.title: Product Engineering
services.description: I take web products from a first sketch to a live launch, architecture, interface, and everything between, built to feel fast and stay easy to maintain.

services.title: Backend & API Development
services.description: Solid server foundations, well-structured APIs, sensible data models, and secure deployments ready for the cloud.
